title: Collaborate to Compete: An Empirical Matching Game Under Incomplete Information in Rank-Order Tournaments
authors: Tat Y. Chan; Yijun Chen; Chunhua Wu
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Structural empirical matching game under incomplete information for team formation in rank-order tournaments, estimated by simulation (Rcpp, differential evolution).
design_notes: estimation.r sources estimation.cpp; loads Estimation_Data.RData (competitions data frame and players_list of team formation choices and performance); estimates the matching-game likelihood. No regressions with treatment timing.
data_files_note: readme.txt describes the estimation data; no statement of simulation or masking.
data_provenance_note: Estimation-ready data; readme does not say it is simulated.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
